values.note: DNR rate table, same for the East and West campgrounds: 20/30-amp $45, 50-amp $50, full hookup $60. Mini cabin $80 ($60 off-season); boat camping $40 (local sale only). A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds, on top of the camping fee.

values.note: Sanitation station near the campground entrance with potable water and four lanes. The park store (day-use area) sells food, firewood, ice and propane and rents kayaks/paddleboards mid-May through September. Two buoyed swim areas in the campground and a campers-only pet beach.

summary: Confirmed on the DNR pages: $45 (20/30-amp) to $60 (full hookup) for 2026, the same in the East and West campgrounds, Recreation Passport in fees.note; season (East May 1 - Oct 31, West May 15 - Oct 14) already manual and unchanged. Added 50-amp/water/sewer, 404 sites with pull-throughs, showers/flush and vault toilets/dump/store, reservable on midnrreservations.com. --AWH note kept (the pages don't contradict it). Not stated for this park: max rig length, booking window/max stay (left inherited).
